$note: Golden wire vector for the Archon bounded canary contract. Generated by scripts/generate-canary-golden-vectors.ts — do not hand-edit; run the generator and commit the result.

authentication.principal_resolution: server-side, by constant-time comparison of the bearer token; a principal field in the request body is REJECTED

$description: A settled receipt for a run that hit its budget ceiling. The aggregate is present and must be settled from — a ceiling hit is a real, billed run, reported as failed because it did not do the work. output_available is false and output_text is ABSENT, not empty: a failed run publishes no deliverable even if the agent left partial text behind.

charge_full_reservation_when: receipt unreadable or absent past the deadline

output_contract.output_bytes_is: UTF-8 byte length of output_text, NOT its UTF-16 string length
output_contract.output_sha256_is: lowercase hex sha256 over exactly those UTF-8 bytes
absent_on: pending receipts (no output block at all)
output_contract.never_truncated: output exceeding max_output_bytes FAILS the run with reason output_too_large; a truncated deliverable is never published
output_contract.succeeded_requires_output: a terminal receipt cannot be succeeded without an available output — an SDK success that produced no final text is downgraded to reason missing_output
output_contract.verify: recompute sha256 over the UTF-8 bytes of output_text and compare to output_sha256 before acting on the deliverable
